reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens has a live caller at market.move:750. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions section in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; refresh_usd_price is a permissionless public fun anyone can call. Gate 3: 'oracle price manipulation' and 'liquidation logic' are explicit focus areas; market.move is in-scope. An attacker can trigger this via the liquidate entry point by first calling refresh_usd_price with a Pyth VAA capturing a temporary spot-price dip (within the 30-second staleness window and within ema_spot_tolerance), causing liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens to compute seized collateral using the depressed get_spot_price rather than the EMA, resulting in systematic over-seizure of borrower collateral proportional to the EMA/spot divergence. No severity_classification thresholds in scope file; original Critical rating is consistent with oracle manipulation in a lending liquidation path.
